The '''Coruscant gladiatorial arena''' was a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], just eighty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this gladiatorial arena hosted highly illegal [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] fights. One of the contenders of this fight circuit was the rancor [[Old One-Eye]].
